notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.5 Hotfix
notes.content: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.5 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes for PC version of the game - 1.0.5 :)[/p][list][*][p]corrected the name of Engineer Kim's second log in SECM (handheld tablet).[/p][/*][*][p]fixed incorrect name of module 04 when the module was unpowered.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed computer logout in module 05 in loop 8.[/p][/*][*][p]improved buttons brightness in game settings in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Personal tablet (SCM) fix: now the item description doesn't stay on screen after entering the inventory in SECM.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23 :) :)[/p][p][/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

tags.bug: corrected the name of Engineer Kim's second log in SECM (handheld tablet).
fixed incorrect name of module 04 when the module was unpowered.
fixed computer logout in module 05 in loop 8.
Personal tablet (SCM) fix: now the item description doesn't stay on screen after entering the inventory in SECM.

notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.4 Hotfix
notes.content: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.4 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes for PC version of the game - 1.0.4 :)[/p][list][*][p]fixed audio settings during all gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a bug with bulkhead in soth corridor where when a fire is active in the corridor the mouse cursor would not appear next to the terminal in loop 1.[/p][/*][*][p]fixed bugs where after changing interaction keys, the new key settings didn't work in some places.[/p][/*][*][p]gamepads - I added an option in terminals and computers that when you press the east button, it returns to the main menu of the computer/terminal.[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes in loop 5.[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes in game translations (EN).[/p][/*][*][p]minor changes and improvement in player movement.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

tags.bug: fixed audio settings during all gameplay.
fixed a bug with bulkhead in soth corridor where when a fire is active in the corridor the mouse cursor would not appear next to the terminal in loop 1.
fixed bugs where after changing interaction keys, the new key settings didn't work in some places.

tags.feature: gamepads - I added an option in terminals and computers that when you press the east button, it returns to the main menu of the computer/terminal.

tags.balance_change: minor changes and improvement in player movement.

notes.title: Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 PC v1.0.3 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Hi, I just uploaded new version with hotfixes - 1.0.3 :)[/p][p]- fixed incorrectly displayed card with clue in loop 5,[/p][p]- fixed menu in loop 5,[/p][p]- gamepads mod: if you log in to the terminal/computer/keypad in game, use the east button on gamepad to return to the start option on the computer or exit the keyboard screen.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

tags.bug: - fixed incorrectly displayed card with clue in loop 5,
- gamepads mod: if you log in to the terminal/computer/keypad in game, use the east button on gamepad to return to the start option on the computer or exit the keyboard screen.

notes.title: Forgotten 23 v1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.content: [h3][b]Forgotten 23 v1.0.2 Hotfix - ChangeLog (EN)[/b][/h3][p]------------------------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Listening to you, players, I have prepared a small HotFix for the game - below is a list of things I have improved:[/p][p]- changing "How to play" screen in Loop 01 for lower resolutions.[/p][p]- if you run SECM and the pause menu - SECM will close automatically now and the character no longer moves when opening and closing pause menu or SECM.[/p][p]- add key E to confirm/submit buttons in SECM and computers/terminals (Enter works too!)[/p][p]- changed incorrect text in the computer in module 2, indicating that you need to "press space" (now it's E/ENTER).[/p][p]- disabled unnecessary repairs in module 05 in loops where it is not needed (what could be blocking progress in game).[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you're enjoying Forgotten 23![/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Lucas / dev[/p]

tags.feature: - add key E to confirm/submit buttons in SECM and computers/terminals (Enter works too!)

tags.bug: - if you run SECM and the pause menu - SECM will close automatically now and the character no longer moves when opening and closing pause menu or SECM.
- changed incorrect text in the computer in module 2, indicating that you need to "press space" (now it's E/ENTER).
- disabled unnecessary repairs in module 05 in loops where it is not needed (what could be blocking progress in game).

notes.title: Forgotten 23 – Available Now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone 👨‍🚀! [/h3][h3]I'm honored to announce that after 18 months of hard work, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815080/Forgotten_23/"]Forgotten 23[/url][b] is finally here![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The deep void of space holds many secrets.
The Forgotten research space station drifts ever closer to Proxima Centauri b. Impact is inevitable... or is it? Time resets. Again and again. And you're trapped inside the loop.[/p][p]In [b]Forgotten 23[/b], a narrative-driven sci-fi adventure, you’ll explore a dark, abandoned station, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mystery behind the endless countdown. Every reset brings new clues—but also new dangers.[/p][p]Atmospheric exploration, unsettling audio design, and an enigmatic story await. Will you break the cycle before time runs out for good?[/p][p][/p][h3]🔑 [b]Key Features:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Immersive top down exploration in a deep sci-fi setting[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental puzzles and hidden secrets[/p][/*][*][p]Time-loop narrative – learn from each reset[/p][/*][*][p]Atmospheric soundtrack and detailed environments
[/p][/*][/list][h3]💞 How You Can Support Me[/h3][p]As a solo developer, there are so many ways you can help support me and the game.[/p][list][*][p]If you buy the game, please consider leaving an honest review on Steam! Reviews have a massive impact on indie games and I'd love to see your thoughts and experiences through a review.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.[/p][/*][*][p]Follow me on [url="https://x.com/Koval_Games"]X/Twitter[/url] to share in the excitement.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The station is silent. The clock is ticking. Escape the loop.  [/b]Play [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815080/Forgotten_23/"]Forgotten 23[/url] today on PC![/p]
